name: conversations.list
description: List conversations visible to a user. Optionally filter by project, target scope, and archived status.

project_id.description: Optional project ID to list conversations for

scope.description: Optional filter by a single conversation scope (ignored when `scopes` is non-empty)

scopes.description: Optional union filter over multiple scopes in one call (overrides `scope`)

org_id.description: Optional organization ID for multi-tenant context

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return

offset.description: Number of conversations to skip for pagination

include_total.description: When false, skips COUNT; `total` is -1 (use page size for pagination hints)
